operations.command: set -e; mkdir -p /opt/materialized-dir; printf 'dir-before\n' > /opt/materialized-dir/token; printf 'file-before\n' > /opt/materialized-file; host=/etc/nixos/nix/hosts/{{arch}}/VM-TEST/VM-TEST.nix; sed -i 's|"/var/log" ];|"/var/log" "/opt/materialized-dir" "/opt/materialized-file" ];|' "$host"; grep -F '"/opt/materialized-dir"' "$host"; grep -F '"/opt/materialized-file"' "$host"; printf materialize-paths-configured
nixos-rebuild switch --flake /etc/nixos#VM-TEST-Standard-Boot && systemctl restart persistence-mounts.service && printf persistence-enabled

set -e; findmnt -rn --target /opt/materialized-dir | grep -F '@persist/dirs/opt!materialized-dir'; cat /opt/materialized-dir/token | grep -F 'dir-before'; cat /opt/materialized-file | grep -F 'file-before'; printf persisted-before

set -e; printf 'dir-after\n' > /opt/materialized-dir/token; printf 'file-after\n' > /opt/materialized-file; host=/etc/nixos/nix/hosts/{{arch}}/VM-TEST/VM-TEST.nix; sed -i 's| "/opt/materialized-dir" "/opt/materialized-file"||' "$host"; nixosctl persistence materialize --refresh-clean; nixos-rebuild boot --flake /etc/nixos#VM-TEST-Standard-Boot; printf materialized-and-removed

set -e; cat /opt/materialized-dir/token | grep -F 'dir-after'; cat /opt/materialized-file | grep -F 'file-after'; test -d /etc/nixos/.git; findmnt -rn --target /etc/nixos | grep -F '@persist/dirs/etc!nixos'; ! findmnt -rn --target /opt/materialized-dir | grep -F '@persist/dirs/opt!materialized-dir'; printf materialized-after
set -e; printf 'dir-transient\n' > /opt/materialized-dir/token; printf 'file-transient\n' > /opt/materialized-file; sync; printf transient-written

set -e; cat /opt/materialized-dir/token | grep -F 'dir-after'; cat /opt/materialized-file | grep -F 'file-after'; ! cat /opt/materialized-dir/token | grep -F 'dir-transient'; ! cat /opt/materialized-file | grep -F 'file-transient'; printf materialized-reset
